_about: NASA TN D-3532 dump-cooled LOX/GH2 engine, copied from page images on 2026-10-25.
source: Pavli, Curley, Masters & Schwartz, NASA TN D-3532 (1966): Fig. 3 contour p. 3; Table I p. 9; Eq. (1) p. 11; Fig. 15 p. 20; Table II p. 44. https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/19660022898

geometry_in.note: Convergence half-angle not printed; any value from 15 to 24.7 deg fits the two 4.352 in. arcs.

ambient_pressure_note: psia = psig + 14.7 assumed; the report does not state the ambient pressure.
coolant: liquid hydrogen; parahydrogen assumed (normal hydrogen gives about 13 % less enthalpy rise)
wall_temperature_note: Fig. 15 (firing 9) shows the calculated flame-side wall between about 1600 and 2900 R (900-1600 K) along the engine (visual reading).
